newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon starts Excel Realty.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon starts Excel Realty.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Jordan Heller started Excel Realty Trust Inc with a strong buy rating. He set earnings estimates of $2.28 per share for 1996, $2.55 for 1997 and $2.77 for 1998.
-- He set a 12-month target price of $30 on the stock. Combined with the company's dividend yield, investors could see gains of 28 percent, "with further upside longer term," he said.
-- The analyst said the strong buy recommendation reflected "our belief that the company has above-trend growth potential, yet below-average price valuation."
